A generative-AI SaaS for image enhancement and transformation, launched
alongside a set of free SEO-focused image utilities that acted as the
acquisition channel. It attracted over 23,000 monthly organic visitors before I
discontinued it.

Built on AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, and SageMaker, with third-party AI APIs for
parts of the generation pipeline.

![Placeholder, replace with a real screenshot.](screenshot-01.png)

## Acquisition

Product analytics ran on Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, and Python,
tracking acquisition, activation, conversion funnels, and SEO performance to
drive iterative improvements.

## Why it stopped

The traffic was real, but the infrastructure economics didn't work at that
conversion rate. Shutting it down was the right call, and the write-up of *why*
is more interesting than the launch. Worth expanding here.
